commands.name: Back
commands.description: Return to the main Stream Deck keys.

commands.name: Buy
commands.description: Send your TradingView Buy hotkey once (TradingView default: Shift+B) using the order panel defaults.
commands.setup: Enter Shift+B (TradingView's Buy shortcut) in this key's settings. A broker must be connected in TradingView; with instant orders on, the order is placed immediately. Test with Paper Trading first. Quantity, order type and confirmations are controlled by TradingView.

commands.name: Sell
commands.description: Send your TradingView Sell hotkey once (TradingView default: Shift+S) using the order panel defaults.
commands.setup: Enter Shift+S (TradingView's Sell shortcut) in this key's settings. A broker must be connected in TradingView; test with Paper Trading first. Quantity, order type and confirmations are controlled by TradingView.
